messages_list.message: I've always wanted to learn how to paint, but I feel like it's too late to start now. All these young people are so talented.
It's never too late to explore a passion! What kind of things do you imagine yourself painting?
I've always loved the beautiful flowers in my garden and the birds that visit. I'd love to be able to capture that on a canvas.
That sounds wonderful! The world is full of beauty, and learning to paint is a beautiful way to connect with it. Every artist starts with a single brushstroke, no matter their age.
